title: Onboarding & Listing Specialist
description: We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028. Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end. Role Mission Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea ---------- mber succeeds or struggles. Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 90 Days) • Time from signed contract to first live booking: under 21 days on 90%+ of new properties. • Owner satisfaction score on onboarding: 9/10 or higher measured via post-onboarding survey. • Zero listing errors at go-live — amenities, photos, pricing, house rules, and descriptions verified and correct. • Pricing strategy configured correctly on day one — dynamic pricing tools set up with appropriate base rates, seasonality, and event-based adjustments. • Full operational handoff document complete for every new property before go-live — cleaning, maintenance, guest experience, and pricing teams receive complete information. • Onboarding SOP maintained and improved quarterly based on what worked and what broke. Core Responsibilities Owner-Facing Onboarding • Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline. • Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor. • Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond. • Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management. Listing Build & Optimization • Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model). • Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion. • Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging. • Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate. Pricing Setup • Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves. • Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules. • Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable. • Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in. Operational Handoff • Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks. • Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives. • Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days. Process Improvement • Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed. • Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality. • Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks. Required Experience & Skills • 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent. • Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or ---------- listings from scratch. • Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez). • Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond). • Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls. • Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details. • Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes. Non-Negotiable Traits • Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip. • Owner-facing confidence. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this." • Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. Short-term rental management is genuinely hard to scale. Every property is different, every guest is different, every owner is different, every vendor is different, and every situation requires judgment. Most companies hit the same wall: they either deliver great personalized service at small scale, or they grow and the service quality quietly falls apart. We are building the company that does not make that trade. We are small and AI-native by design. We use AI tools, automation, and tight operating systems to deliver service at a level legacy property managers cannot match without hiring far more people. This role is for someone who wants to join that operating system from the inside. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a general operations support role with an AI systems growth path. You will be assigned into one of our operating divisions, such as guest communication, maintenance coordination, cleanings, owner support, reservations, vendor coordination, or internal operations. You will start by doing the actual work. That part matters. You cannot improve a system you do not understand. You cannot train AI on a workflow you have never lived. You cannot build better SOPs, templates, escalation rules, or automations unless you know where the real friction is. So the path is simple: Learn the division Do the work Document the patterns Identify what breaks repeatedly Help improve the workflow Help train AI and automation around the work Grow into more ownership as the company scales This is not a basic VA role. We are not looking for someone who only wants to complete tasks forever. We are looking for someone who can become excellent inside an operating function, then help us make that function smarter, faster, and more scalable. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Every operating division at OODA has the same core challenge: There are lots of small decisions happening all the time. A guest asks a question. A cleaner reports a problem. A vendor texts back late. An owner needs an update. A maintenance issue needs triage. A task is missing context. A process works 80% of the time, but fails in edge cases. Most companies solve this by hiring more people. We are solving it by building better systems. The person we want is not just someone who says, “I completed the task.” The person we want says: “Why did this task exist?” “Why did this break?” “What information was missing?” “What should the SOP say?” “What could AI handle next time?” “What should still require a human?” “How do we make this easier for the next person?” That is the mindset. You will do real operational work, but the long-term opportunity is to help build the system behind the work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your exact responsibilities will depend on the division you are assigned to, but may include: Responding to guest, owner, vendor, or tea ---------- ssages Coordinating maintenance, cleanings, inspections, or property tasks Updating internal task systems so the team always knows what is happening Following SOPs, checklists, templates, and escalation rules Identifying issues that need human judgment Escalating problems clearly and correctly Tracking repeated questions, bottlenecks, delays, and recurring problems Helping improve SOPs, templates, checklists, and workflows Using AI tools to draft, summarize, classify, organize, and improve work Helping train AI-assisted workflows with real examples from the business Giving feedback on what the system gets right and wrong Helping turn messy real-world operations into cleaner repeatable processes You do not need to be a software developer. But you should be excited to work in a company where the goal is to use AI, automation, and operational discipline to make the business better every week. THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. But we are not hiring for a temporary task list. We are building a team. As OODA grows, each operating division will need people who can own more responsibility. Guest communication, maintenance, cleanings, owner support, vendor coordination, internal QA, AI training, process improvement, and operations management all become more important as we scale. The best people in these seats will not just do the work. They will help define how the work should be done. That means: Better SOPs Better AI prompts Better message templates Better escalation rules Better quality control Better dashboards Better reporting Better training data Better workflows between humans and AI For the right person, this can become a full-time role after the initial period. As OODA grows, we want to build long-term roles around the people who prove they can own real parts of the operation. That may mean expanded hours, full-time contractor work, a formal employment role, division ownership, team leadership, or a more specialized AI operations position. The starting point is operations. The growth path is ownership. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is: COMMUNICATION Excellent in written English Strong in spoken English preferred Fluent Spanish strongly preferred Clear, calm, and professional Able to explain issues without drama or confusion Able to write like a thoughtful human, not a script or translation tool TEMPERAMENT Calm under pressure Reliable during the agreed schedule Detail-oriented Comfortable with repetitive work at first Hungry for more responsibility over time Not too proud to start by doing the work directly JUDGMENT Knows when to solve and when to escalate Follows SOPs without becoming robotic Notices patterns Thinks in root causes Can handle ambiguity without freezing Can be trusted with real operational responsibility SYSTEMS AND AI Comfortable learning new software tools Curious about AI, automation, and process improvement Interested in helping train and improve AI-assisted workflows Able to use tools like ChatGPT thoughtfully Excited by the idea of doing the work first, then helping improve the system You should be the kind of person who completes a task correctly, then asks: “Why did this take so many steps, and how could we make it better?” That mindset matters more than any single tool on your resume.

title: Real Estate ISA
description: We're hiring a full-time Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to run point on lead outreach for Savor Properties — a real estate agent in Northern Virginia. Your job is simple: call every lead the moment they come in, follow up on a consistent cadence, and book appointments between qualified sellers and our owner, Jay. You are not closing deals. You are opening conversations. The best ISAs don't pitch — they listen. They ask good questions. They make the homeowner feel understood before anything else happens. Your edge is empathy and urgency, not a script you're rushing through. What You'll Be Doing Inbound Lead Response Every lead that comes in gets a call. Not in 5 minutes. Not "when you get a chance." Within 10 seconds of receipt — every time. Speed to lead is the standard. This is non-negotiable. Follow-Up Cadence Leads that don't pick up get worked. You'll follow a structured follow-up sequence — calls, texts, voi cemail s — until you get a conversation or the lead is officially dead. Nothing falls through the cracks. Cold Calling When you're not following up with existing leads, you're dialing cold lists. Lists are provided — your job is to work through them consistently, keep your energy up, and find the people who need what we offer. Appointment Setting The goal of every conversation is to understand the homeowner's situation and — if they're a fit — book them for an appointment with Jay. You qualify. Jay closes. CRM Management Every call, every outcome, every follow-up is logged in Follow Up Boss. You keep your pipeline clean and your notes sharp. No mystery leads, no ghost activity. Daily Sales Check-In Every day, we review your calls and your numbers together. This isn't a performance review — it's a feedback loop. We'll listen to calls, talk through what's working, and sharpen what isn't. The best ISAs get better every single week because they're coachable and they pay attention to the data. How to Be a Hero Meeting the standard gets you in the door. This is how you become someone we'd never let go. You push past the first "no." Not with pressure — with genuine curiosity. You ask one more question, you dig one level deeper, and you find out if there's actually something there. Average ISAs hang up. Great ones turn a "not interested" into a 10-minute conversation. You bring insights to the check-in. You're not just showing up with numbers. You're showing up with observations. "I noticed leads from this list are going cold faster — here's what I think is happening." You're thinking about the pipeline, not just dialing through it. You find patterns before we do. Best time to call, which scripts are landing, which objections keep coming up — you're tracking it without being asked. You turn your call activity into intelligence we can actually use. You make Jay look good in every handoff. When you book an appointment, Jay walks in with context. You've qualified the lead, you've logged the situation, and Jay isn't starting from zero. The handoff is seamless because you made it that way. You get better every week. You listen back to your own calls. You apply feedback. You don't make the same mistake twice. The ISAs who thrive here are the ones who are always improving — not the ones who think they've already figured it out. How to Drive Me Crazy Going quiet after a call. Log it. Every time. Letting leads sit. Speed to lead isn't a suggestion — it's the standard. Winging follow-up. There's a cadence. Follow it. Burning out and going silent. This is a high-volume role. If you're struggling, say something — don't just disappear. Needing to be reminded. You own your pipeline. I shouldn't have to check your activity to find out what's happening. Qualifications Proven experience in phone sales, ISA work, or high-volume outreach — real estate experience is a plus, not a requirement. Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, and professional. title: Senior Property Manager
description: About This Role This is a career-level property management position — not a virtual assistant role. Suites by VTJ is a property management company based in Raleigh, North Carolina. We manage a mixed portfolio of long-term residential, commercial, and short-term rental properties. Part of our tenant base communicates exclusively in Spanish, and we need a Senior Property Manager who can serve both English and Spanish-speaking tenants at the same professional standard. You will be the operational decision-maker for the portfolio. The Junior Assistant Property Manager reports to you. The CEO trusts you to handle what requires judgment and expects to be involved only when it truly needs ownership-level input. If you have real property management experience, a proven remote work track record, and the discipline to run a portfolio without daily supervision — this role was built for you. What You Will Own Lease Operations: Review and finalize all lease agreements, renewals, addenda, and amendments before they go out for signature. You are the last check — nothing with a legal implication leaves without your review. Coordinate DocuSign routing and confirm completion at every stage. Tenant Relationship Management: Handle all escalated tenant communications — complaints, disputes, delinquency conversations, move-in and move-out coordination. Manage the full scope of Spanish-language tenant accounts without routing through the CEO. Respond to all tenant messages within the 2-hour standard during your shift. Rent Collection Follow-Through: Ensure all late accounts have a documented touchpoint by the 3rd of every month without exception. Send reminders, issue late notices, document every step, and hand clean records to the accounting team. Conduct payment plan conversations with professionalism and firmness in both English and Spanish. Maintenance Oversight and Vendor Management: Track every open maintenance ticket from report to confirmed resolution. Hold vendors accountable to their timelines. Verify insurance certificates and contract compliance. Update tenants proactively — no tenant should ever have to ask for a status update on an open ticket. Junior APM Direction and Quality Control: Review the Junior APM's daily output before it reaches tenants. Catch errors, address them directly, and raise communication and documentation standards over time. Their performance is part of your accountability. Compliance and Emergency Readiness: Keep all properties compliant with HOA rules, local policy, and vendor contract requirements. Maintain an up-to-date emergency contact and response protocol for each property so urgent after-hours situations have a clear first action. Skills Required Property Management Skills - Lease administration: drafting, reviewing, and finalizing residential and commercial leases, addenda, and amendments - Tenant communication and relationship management — English and Spanish - Rent collection management: reminders, late notices, payment plans, and documentation - Maintenance coordination: ticket tracking, vendor follow-up, insurance certificate verification - Move-in and move-out coordination: inspections, key handoffs, deposit documentation - Lease renewal management: proactive outreach, negotiation, and completion - HOA compliance: routing notices, maintaining records, flagging violations - Vacancy management: tour coordination, prospect communication, and conversion - E-signature workflow management (DocuSign or equivalent) Technical and Tool Skills - Property Management Software: DoorLoop (preferred) or Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi, or equivalent — proficiency required - Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Google Calendar — daily use - Project Management: ClickUp or equivalent — task tracking and workflow management - Communication: Slack for internal messaging, Ooma or VoIP for tenant and vendor calls - Time Tracking: Hubstaff — used for remote accountability during shift hours - Video Meetings: Google Meet for team check-ins and candidate interviews - Document Design: Canva — basic tenant communication materials when needed Soft Skills - Extreme attention to detail: documents, dates, dollar amounts, and addenda — especially under time pressure - Remote self-management: ability to run a full workday without a manager present, with proactive communication discipline - Independent judgment: makes decisions at the portfolio level and escalates only what genuinely requires CEO input - Professional written and verbal English: tenant notices, lease correspondence, and vendor communication - Professional written and verbal Spanish: strongly preferred — formal tenant correspondence, complaints, and collections calls - De-escalation: calm, firm, and solutions-oriented with difficult or upset tenants in both languages - Team direction: raises the output quality of a junior tea ---------- mber through direct, specific, non-punishing feedback - Prioritization under pressure: manages multiple open items across multiple properties simultaneously without dropping details - Ownership mindset: closes every loop, documents every touchpoint, and surfaces problems before they become visible to leadership You Are the Right Fit If - You have 3 or more years in property management, leasing, or real estate operations - You have managed both residential and commercial properties — single-family-only experience is a gap for this portfolio - You have worked fully remote before and can describe what your personal accountability system looks like - You have directed or reviewed a junior tea ---------- mber's work and corrected their output directly - You write and speak Spanish at a professional level — formal correspondence, not just conversational - Your home office is ready: 60 Mbps or faster, dual monitors, 16 GB+ RAM or Mac, dedicated headset, quiet private workspace This Role Is Not For You If - You need daily task lists to know what to prioritize - You have only worked in-office or hybrid and have no fully-remote track record - Difficult tenant conversations — in either language — make you uncomfortable - Documentation is something you do when you remember, not as a first instinct Home Office Requirements Your setup is verified during the interview. Minimum standards: - Internet: 60 Mbps download or faster (screenshot required at application) - Monitors: Dual monitors - Computer: Modern multi-core CPU, 16 GB+ RAM, or Mac equivalent - Audio: Professional-grade headset — no laptop speakers or earbuds - Workspace: Private, quiet, and professional-looking on camera Hiring Process 1. Application — Four knockout questions + internet speed screenshot. Incomplete applications are not reviewed. 2. Pre-Assessment — 45–60 minute written assessment sent to passing applicants only. Tests scenario judgment, written communication, remote work discipline, and personality fit. 3. Google Meet Interview — 45-minute structured behavioral interview with the CEO. Includes a live workspace verification. Bilingual candidates will be checked on Spanish during the call. 4. Reference Checks — Finalists arrange calls between the CEO and two former direct supervisors. This step is mandatory. We tell every candidate this at the start. 5. Offer — Extended to one finalist on the day the decision is made. About Suites by VTJ Suites by VTJ is a fast-moving, high-accountability property management company in Raleigh, NC. We manage a mixed portfolio and operate with a lean remote team that holds a high bar. The standard we hire to is the standard the business runs to.

title: Operations Manager - UK Serviced Accommodation (13 Properties) - Run Our Whole Operation
job_title: Operations Manager - UK Serviced Accommodation (13 Properties) - Run Our Whole Operation
description: Luxstay Ventures is a UK serviced accommodation company managing 13 short-stay rental properties across Brighton, Watford, and Leicester. We host guests on Airbnb, ---------- , VRBO, and direct. We manage properties for owners and JV partners. We are hiring an Operations Manager to OWN our daily operations end to end. This is not a task-taking VA role. You will run the operation. The director is stepping back from day-to-day operations to focus on growth, and we need someone who can hold the whole thing together: guests, cleaners, standards, maintenance, and reporting, across all 13 properties, without being told what to do each day. You will have a full operations manual, video training, and a clear escalation framework from day one. If you are the kind of person who builds systems, closes loops, and takes genuine ownership, you will thrive here and grow with us as we scale toward 20+ properties. -- THE SKILLS THAT MATTER MOST FOR THIS ROLE -- Quality control with evidence. You enforce property standards using checklists and photo proof. You work to a clear "definition of done" for every turnover. You do not accept "it's cleaned" without verification. Root-cause problem solving. When an issue comes up, you do not just log it and move on. You resolve it fully and prevent it from happening again. You keep an issues and defects log and you close items properly. Calm guest resolution under pressure. You handle complaints and difficult guests with a professional, calm tone. You know when to reassure, when to offer a solution, and critically, when to escalate to the director instead of acting alone. Time-critical claim handling. You understand that damage claims and disputes have strict deadlines (AirCover is 14 days from checkout, before the next guest; guest complaints need a response within 24 hours). You move fast to gather photo evidence and protect the business. Experience with AirCover, Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence is a strong advantage. Running a cadence. You work to a daily and weekly rhythm. You know what gets checked every morning, what gets reported every week, and you keep the operation moving without drift. Multi-property organisation. You can hold 13 properties in your head at once and make sure nothing slips. You have a system for this, not just good intentions. -- WHAT YOU WILL OWN -- Guest Communications: All guest messages across all 13 properties and all channels. Fast, professional responses. Full guest journey from enquiry to post-checkout. Cleaning Team Management: You manage our cleaning teams directly (Watford, Brighton, Leicester). Confirm every turnover. Verify photo checklists in Turno after every clean. Chase incomplete cleans. You are the bridge between us and the cleaners. Property Standards and QA: Enforce standards with checklists and photo evidence. Maintain the issues log. Drive recurring problems to zero. Maintenance Coordination: When something breaks, you own the fix. Contact contractors, schedule the repair, follow up until it is closed, keep the director informed. You coordinate this remotely using our on-the-ground cleaners and contractors. Reviews and Reputation: Monitor and respond to all guest reviews. Draft responses for approval where needed. Flag negatives immediately and help protect our rating. One of our properties needs rating recovery and you will help lead that. Reporting: Daily operations summary to the director. Weekly performance report covering occupancy, issues, cleaning status, and guest feedback. -- WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO -- Change pricing, rates, or minimum stays (handled separately, view-only access) Bookkeeping or Xero (we have a dedicated bookkeeper) Approve refunds or cancellations without director sign-off Communicate with property owners or investors (director handles this) Cold sales or outreach -- TOOLS (full training provided) -- Uplisting (channel manager), Turno (cleaning + photo verification), PriceLabs (view only), Slack (team comms), WhatsApp (cleaner coordination), Airbnb, ---------- , VRBO, Google Calendar -- REQUIREMENTS -- At least 3 years in short-term rental or serviced accommodation operations Proven experience managing or coordinating cleaning teams and contractors Hands-on experience with a channel manager (Uplisting, Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, or similar) Demonstrable experience resolving guest complaints and disputes independently Strong written English with a calm, professional, friendly tone Genuinely organised and proactive. You run things, you do not wait to be told WhatsApp on your phone, reliable internet, laptop with Chrome -- STRONG ADVANTAGE -- Experience managing 10+ properties simultaneously Experience with AirCover claims, Airbnb Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence Experience with Turno or similar photo-verification cleaning software Experience training or managing other VAs (we will scale and you may build a team under you) UK market experience -- COMPENSATION -- $720 USD per month for full-time (40 hours/week) Paid monthly via Tap Tap Send 13th month bonus in December 30-day performance review Clear growth path: as we scale toward 20+ properties, this role grows in pay and responsibility, potentially building and leading an operations team under you -- HOW ONBOARDING WORKS -- Week 1: Watch the Loom training library, read the operations manual, meet the cleaning teams, shadow how we work. You learn before you act. Week 2: You take on guest messaging and cleaning verification with the director reviewing your work daily. Weeks 3-4: You take full ownership of daily operations. The director reviews your daily summary. This is a 30-day paid trial. If we are both happy, this becomes a permanent senior role. -- TO APPLY -- Answer ALL FOUR questions. Generic or copy-paste applications will be deleted unread. 1. A guest at our Brighton property messages at 10am: "there is mould in the bathroom, this is disgusting, I want a refund or I am leaving a 1-star review." Walk me through exactly what you do, who you contact, what you say to the guest, and in what order. 2. You check Turno after a checkout and the cleaner has uploaded no photos. The next guest checks in at 3pm. It is now 11am. Walk me through your exact next steps. 3. A guest checks out and you discover they have damaged a bed. Walk me through what you do to make sure we can actually recover the cost. Be specific about timing and evidence. 4. You are running 13 properties at once. Describe the actual system or daily routine you use to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Tell me about a real system you have used before, not what you would do in theory. In your first line, tell me the most properties you have managed at one time, and the channel manager you have used most.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description: The Opportunity Legacy Property Buyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company that specializes in helping homeowners sell their properties through creative solutions, including cash purchases, wholesale deals, and novations. We are hiring a Full-Time Transaction Coordinator to help manage our real estate deals from contract to closing. This is not a basic admin role. This is not a “just update a spreadsheet and wait for instructions” position. You will be responsible for helping keep deals organized, moving, documented, and on track while communicating with title companies, agents, lenders, buyers, internal tea ---------- mbers, and other parties involved in the transaction. If you are looking for an easy remote job where you can move slowly, wait to be told everything, or avoid pressure, this is not it. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, excellent at communication, and able to keep multiple deals moving without constant supervision, keep reading. We are looking for someone who can work EST business hours, communicate in excellent English, move quickly, follow up aggressively, and take ownership of the closing process. Compensation: Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and real estate transaction coordination background. Expected compensation may include: Monthly base pay Closed deal bonus Accuracy/performance bonus This role is full-time and long-term. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, become a key part of our operations, and help us close deals faster and more consistently. This is a role where strong operators are rewarded for accuracy, ownership, and consistency. What You’ll Own: Your job is to help manage real estate transactions from contract to closing and make sure every deal is organized, updated, followed up on, and moving forward. You will own the operational side of the deal process, including title coordination, document tracking, deadline management, transaction updates, closing checklists, buyer/seller file organization, and internal communication. Your performance will be measured by your ability to: Keep deals moving toward closing Follow up with title companies, agents, lenders, and buyers Maintain accurate transaction records Track missing documents and deadlines Communicate clearly with the internal team Catch issues early before they become fires Keep Podio, Slack, Google Drive, and deal records updated Help reduce the workload from our Dispositions Manager Maintain a high level of accuracy without needing to be babysat This role is about ownership, speed, accuracy, and communication. Core Responsibilities 1. Transaction Coordination + Deal Management You will help manage active deals once they are under contract and assist with moving them toward closing. You will be responsible for: Opening title when needed Confirming title has received the correct documents Tracking title company contact information Tracking escrow officer information Monitoring earnest money deposit status Tracking buyer and seller documents Tracking closing dates and key deadlines Following up with title companies for updates Confirming payoffs, liens, taxes, judgments, and title issues are being handled Updating the internal team on transaction progress Keeping every active deal organized and moving forward You must be comfortable following up with people repeatedly and professionally until the task is complete. This is not a passive role. You are expected to push deals forward. 2. Title Company, Agent, Buyer, and Lender Communication You will communicate with different parties involved in real estate transactions. You will be responsible for: Email ing and calling title companies for updates Coordinating with real estate agents on novation/listing deals Following up with buyers and buyer agents when needed Tracking lender timelines when a buyer is using financing Confirming inspections, appraisals, and closing requirements Requesting missing documents Sending reminders before deadlines Escalating issues to the Dispositions Manager when needed You do not need to be aggressive or rude, but you do need to be confident, clear, and persistent. If someone is delaying the deal, we need to know quickly. 3. Documentation + File Accuracy Every deal must be clean, organized, and accurate. You will be responsible for: Uploading documents to the correct deal file Naming documents clearly Confirming documents match the correct property Tracking purchase agreements, novation agreements, amendments, buyer contracts, EMD receipts, listing documents, closing statements, and other deal paperwork Making sure Google Drive and Podio are updated Verifying important information before marking tasks complete Catching missing or incorrect information Accuracy matters. A wrong price, wrong closing date, wrong buyer name, wrong seller name, or wrong document can create serious problems. The standard is simple: If it is not accurate, it is not complete. 4. Closing Checklist + Deadline Management You will help maintain the closing checklist for every active transaction. You will be responsible for tracking: Contract date Closing date Title company Escrow officer Buyer information Seller information EMD status Missing documents Payoff status Title issues Inspection/appraisal timeline Financing status Settlement statement status Final closing confirmation You should always know: What is the current status of the deal? What is missing? Who owes us something? What is the next step? Is the deal at risk? Does Chris need to step in? Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 5. Internal Communication + Updates We are a remote team, so clear communication is required. You will be responsible for: Posting clear deal updates in Slack Updating Podio accurately Communicating blockers early Asking for clarification when information is unclear Keeping the Dispositions Manager updated Sending daily or weekly transaction status reports Making sure every deal has a clear next action No vague updates. Bad update: “Waiting on title.” Good update: “Title confirmed they received the contract. They are waiting on the seller payoff authorization. I email ed the seller at 10:15am and followed up with title at 12:30pm. Next step: follow up again tomorrow morning if not received.” We need clear communication that tells the team exactly where things stand. 6. Escalation + Problem Spotting You are not expected to solve every high-level issue by yourself, but you are expected to spot problems early. You will be responsible for escalating when: Title is not responding Seller documents are missing Buyer EMD has not been deposited Closing date is at risk A lien, judgment, tax issue, or payoff problem appears The settlement statement does not show our expected payout Buyer financing is delayed Realtor/agent communication becomes unclear Seller or buyer behavior creates risk A deal may not close on time The worst thing you can do is stay quiet while a deal slowly falls apart. If something looks off, speak up early. Necessary Skills You need to be strong in the following areas: Excellent English communication, written and verbal Strong attention to detail Organization Follow-up discipline Speed of execution Calendar and deadline management Professional email communication Phone confidence Problem-solving Ability to manage multiple deals at once Ability to work independently Ability to stay calm under pressure High ownership Accuracy with numbers, names, dates, and documents Comfort using CRMs and online systems Ability to ask questions instead of guessing Strong internet research skills Coachability You do not need to know everything about wholesale and novation real estate deals on day one, but you do need to be sharp, detail-oriented, proactive, and willing to learn quickly. Who This Role Is For: You will likely thrive here if you are: Extremely organized Detail-oriented Proactive Comfortable following up with people repeatedly Strong in written English Confident enough to call title companies, agents, buyers, and lenders Able to work EST business hours Comfortable working remotely Calm under pressure Able to manage many moving parts Good at keeping records clean and accurate Able to notice when something looks wrong Willing to ask questions instead of guessing Comfortable being held accountable Looking for a long-term role with a growing company This is a good fit for someone who enjoys operations, organization, communication, and making sure deals get completed correctly. Who This Role Is NOT For Do not apply if: You need constant supervision to stay productive You are careless with details You avoid phone calls You are afraid to follow up with people You wait around instead of taking initiative You make excuses when mistakes happen You are not comfortable working EST hours You struggle with written English You do not like deadlines You get overwhelmed by multiple tasks You guess instead of asking questions You move slowly You dislike accountability You want a low-pressure remote job This role is remote, but it is not relaxed. Deals move fast. Deadlines matter. Accuracy matters. Requirements & Non-Negotiables: - Excellent fluent English communication, written and verbal - Ability to work EST business hours - Reliable computer - High-speed internet - Quiet work environment - Full-time availability - Strong attention to detail - Comfortable making phone calls - Comfortable following up by email , phone, and Slack - Strong organization skills - Ability to manage multiple transactions at once - Ability to work independently without being micromanaged - Comfortable using online systems, CRMs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and email - Willing to learn our real estate process - High personal standards and strong accountability - Preferred But Not Required - Previous real estate transaction coordination experience - Experience working with U.S. real estate investors - Experience working with title companies - Experience with wholesale real estate - Experience with novation/listing transactions - Experience with Podio - Experience with Slack - Experience with Google Sheets - Experience with real estate documents and closing statements Our Standards & Values This is a performance culture. We value: - Competitive Greatness - Unimpeachable Character - Sincere Candor If you avoid accountability, move slowly, or need constant reminders, this will not be a fit. If you are organized, proactive, detail-oriented, coachable, and able to keep deals moving, you will have a serious opportunity here. We are a small team, so every person matters. What You’ll Get - 100% remote work - Full-time long-term opportunity - Real estate transaction coordination training - Experience with wholesale and novation deal structures - Direct access to leadership - Opportunity to grow with the company - Performance-based bonus potential - A clear role with real responsibility - A young, aggressive, growth-minded team - A position where accuracy, speed, and ownership are recognized You will learn how real estate investment transactions move from contract to closing and become a key part of helping the company close more deals. How to Apply When you apply, include the following: - A short paragraph explaining your real estate, admin, operations, or transaction coordination experience - Your previous experience working with U.S.-based companies, if any - Your experience with CRMs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack, Podio, or similar tools - Your current location and time zone - Confirmation that you can work EST business hours - Your internet speed - A short explanation of why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role - A 1–2 minute Loom/video introduction explaining your background and why you want this role Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed. Job Details Job Type: Full-time Location: Remote Preferred Location: Philippines Schedule: EST business hours Compensation: Monthly base pay + closed deal bonus + performance/accuracy bonus Role Type: Transaction Coordination / Real Estate Operations Final Note: This is an important operations role inside a fast-moving real estate investment company. You will be expected to follow up, communicate clearly, keep files accurate, update systems, track deadlines, and help make sure deals close. If you want an easy admin job, this is not the right fit. If you are organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and want to become a key part of a growing real estate company, we want to hear from you.

job_title: Director of Short Term Rental Operations
description: About the Company We are a done-for-you Airbnb arbitrage management company. We find profitable short-term rental units for our clients, set them up, and then run the entire operation on their behalf for a full year — guests, cleaners, pricing, listing health, maintenance, the works. We currently manage 6 properties and are scaling to 100+ units across 6–10 US markets in the next 12 months. We have a separate department that handles initial property acquisition and setup. We are now hiring our first Head of STR Operations to take the entire management division off the founder's plate and scale it. About the Role We are looking for a sharp, Airbnb Property Manager to own our day-to-day portfolio operations. You will be the person who makes sure no listing gets suspended, no review attack goes unanswered, no maintenance issue festers, and no guest situation reaches the founder. You will oversee a 50–100+ unit Airbnb arbitrage portfolio across multiple US markets, build and lead a team of operations VAs underneath you, handle every Airbnb platform issue that arises, manage dynamic pricing across the portfolio, and build the SOPs that turn this into a scalable machine. If you need to be told what to do when a listing gets suspended on a Friday night, this is not the right role for you. If you've handled that exact situation a hundred times before, this is exactly the right role. What You'll Own Day-to-Day -Oversee portfolio performance across all properties: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and listing health. Know the numbers cold every Monday. -Handle every Airbnb platform issue end-to-end: listing suspensions, account warnings, review removal requests, Superhost status, account-level escalations. You write the appeals; you make the phone calls. -Build and maintain relationships with Airbnb support and account managers. Get a named account manager assigned to our portfolio within your first 90 days. -Manage dynamic pricing across the portfolio using PriceLabs or Wheelhouse. Audit base rates, minimum stays, and market conditions weekly. -Triage maintenance issues and delegate to local vendors via your team. Make sure nothing sits in the queue longer than 24 hours. -Hire, train, and manage a team of operations VAs underneath you. Run weekly 1:1s and a daily standup. Know each person's numbers. -Build the full SOP library from the ground up: guest communication, escalation protocols, cleaner coordination, listing health audits, review response, maintenance workflows. We have basic systems. You will systematize the rest. -Handle the rare guest or landlord escalation that requires senior judgment, including occasional phone calls with US-based clients and master-lease landlords. -Report weekly to the founder: what's working, what's broken, what you're fixing this week. You Are the Right Fit If... -You have 5+ years of short-term rental / vacation rental operations experience, with at least 3 of those years in a senior or management role. -You have personally managed 100+ properties in a single portfolio. You can tell us the exact unit count, the markets, and how many people reported to you. -You have handled Airbnb listing suspensions before — and you have a track record of getting them reversed. You can walk us through a specific one start to finish. -You are fluent with at least one major PMS: Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez. You know how to configure automated messages, build reports, and integrate channels. -You have direct hands-on experience with revenue management tools — PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or Beyond. You don't just look at the dashboard; you adjust the strategy. -You have managed at least 3 direct reports before. You can name them, recite their results, and tell us what happened to each one. -You are a native or near-native English writer — clear, professional, direct. No fluff. -You have a clear, neutral business-English speaking voice. You're comfortable on Zoom and on the phone with US founders, landlords, and Airbnb support. -You operate with high autonomy. When the numbers slip, you have a hypothesis by lunch and a fix in motion by Friday. -You have stable fiber internet (50 Mbps+), backup power or UPS, and a real workspace. -You are available to work full-time during US Eastern Time hours. Nice to Have -Background at Vacasa, Evolve, AvantStay, Sextant Stays, Kasa, Sonder, Hostaway, Guesty, or a similar large STR operator. Direct experience specifically with Airbnb arbitrage (managing rented units, not just owned ones). -An existing relationship with an Airbnb account manager. -Experience building SOP libraries from scratch. -Experience hiring and managing offshore VAs. -Familiarity with multi-market US STR operations. What This Is NOT -This is not a guest communications role. You will manage the people who do guest comms; you will not be the one answering messages all day. -This is not a role for someone who has only managed their own properties. We need someone who has run a portfolio for an employer at meaningful scale. -This is not a role for someone who needs hand-holding. The founder is hiring you specifically so he no longer has to think about operations. -This is not part time. We do not consider candidates with other clients or side gigs. Compensation -$3,500 – $5,500 USD/month base salary, depending on experience and proven portfolio size. Paid monthly via Wise. Performance bonus tied to portfolio KPIs (occupancy, listing health, review average, response time). = 15–25% of base annually. -On track earnings of $4,600 to $6,875 USD a month -Profit-share opportunity in the management division after 6–12 months of proven performance. -Performance-based base raises available after 90 days. title: Digital Experience & Website Strategist
description: Digital Experience & Website Strategist Remote Independent Contractor (Philippines) About Us We are building two complementary leadership and impact-focused organizations: Mastering Ministry Mastering Ministry is a Church Development Advisory dedicated to helping pastors, ministry leaders, churches, and faith-based organizations strengthen leadership, communication, ministry systems, organizational health, and community impact. Vision for Impact Vision for Impact is a leadership and organizational development advisory that helps businesses, entrepreneurs, nonprofits, public sector organizations, and community leaders strengthen leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, change readiness, organizational effectiveness, and community impact. Together, these organizations share a common mission: helping leaders move from vision to meaningful and sustainable impact. Our Philosophy We believe technology should support people, not replace them. While we embrace AI-powered tools and emerging technologies, we also believe that meaningful communication, audience understanding, strategic thinking, and human insight remain essential. Artificial Intelligence (AI) can accelerate development, but Human Intelligence (HI) is what creates relevance, connection, trust, and impact. Our goal is not simply to build websites. Our goal is to create digital experiences that help people learn, engage, connect, and take meaningful action. Position Overview We are seeking a Digital Experience & Website Strategist who can help design, build, maintain, and continuously improve the digital presence of both Mastering Ministry and Vision for Impact. This role goes beyond website development. We are looking for someone who understands that effective digital experiences begin with understanding the people being served. The successful candidate will help create websites that communicate clearly, build trust, encourage engagement, and support the growth of both organizations. This role requires someone who can appreciate the unique needs of both ministry and marketplace audiences and help create digital experiences that effectively serve each audience while maintaining a cohesive brand experience. Why This Role Matters Our websites serve as the primary gateway through which people discover our work, engage with our services, access resources, register for workshops, book consultations, and learn about our mission. The work completed through this role will support: Pastors and church leaders Ministry teams Nonprofit organizations Business owners Entrepreneurs Executives Public sector leaders Community stakeholders The digital experiences you help create will play an important role in how people perceive, understand, and engage with our organizations. Key Responsibilities Website Design & Development Design, build, maintain, and improve websites that support our advisory services, workshops, coaching programs, speaking engagements, and leadership development initiatives. Responsibilities may include: Designing and building pages within Wix Studio and Wix Editor Creating service pages, workshop pages, coaching pages, resource pages, and event pages Developing intuitive website navigation and user journeys Structuring information in a way that is easy to understand and act upon Building registration, inquiry, booking, and contact experiences Maintaining and updating website content Ensuring mobile responsiveness and accessibility Supporting overall website performance and usability Audience & User Experience Strategy A critical part of this role is understanding the audiences we serve. Responsibilities may include: Learning about the audiences served by both organizations Understanding the differences between ministry and marketplace audiences Recommending website structures and user journeys based on audience needs Identifying opportunities to improve visitor engagement and conversion Evaluating how content, design, and functionality work together to support organizational goals Helping ensure visitors can easily find information and take meaningful action We are particularly interested in candidates who understand that successful websites are designed around user needs rather than personal preferences. AI-Assisted Website Development We encourage the use of AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, accelerate development, and support creativity. Examples may include: Rocket Emergent AI Lovable Cursor Replit Other AI-assisted development tools However, we are not looking for someone who simply generates websites using AI and publishes the results. We are looking for someone who understands how to combine AI capabilities with human judgment, audience understanding, strategic thinking, and creativity. The successful candidate will use AI to accelerate workflows while still evaluating: Whether the design supports organizational objectives Whether the content resonates with the intended audience Whether the user experience feels intuitive and engaging Whether the website communicates credibility and trust Whether the final solution reflects the mission and goals of the organization Strategic Recommendations & Continuous Improvement We are not looking for someone who simply executes instructions. We value contractors who: Ask thoughtful questions Bring new ideas Recommend improvements Identify opportunities Share constructive feedback Challenge assumptions respectfully when appropriate Contribute strategic recommendations that strengthen the digital experience The ideal candidate acts as a collaborative partner rather than an order taker. The Ideal Candidate We are not simply looking for someone who can build websites. We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in understanding people, organizations, and the impact we are trying to create. The ideal candidate is naturally curious and enjoys learning about leadership, communication, ministry, organizational development, community engagement, and user experience. You should enjoy understanding audiences before proposing solutions. One of the most important aspects of this role is the ability to appreciate two distinct but complementary audiences: Mastering Ministry Audiences Pastors Church leaders Ministry teams Faith-based organizations Vision for Impact Audiences Business leaders Entrepreneurs Nonprofit organizations Government and public sector leaders Community stakeholders The successful candidate will recognize that these audiences may have different expectations, communication styles, motivations, and needs. You should be able to create digital experiences that speak effectively to both groups while supporting a unified mission focused on leadership, growth, and impact. Applicants do not need ministry experience; however, they should be comfortable working with faith-based organizations and communicating respectfully within ministry environments. The strongest candidates will demonstrate: Strategic thinking Audience empathy Curiosity Creativity Strong communication skills Problem-solving abilities Initiative and ownership A commitment to continuous learning Contractor Engagement This is a remote independent contractor opportunity. Work volume will vary based on project needs and business growth. Some weeks may require only a few hours of support, while other weeks may require up to 20 hours. Contractors are expected to manage their own schedules while meeting agreed-upon deadlines and maintaining consistent communication regarding project progress and availability. This role is intended to begin as a flexible contractor engagement with opportunities for increased responsibility and work volume as the business grows. To Apply Please submit: 1. Resume 2. Portfolio Please include examples of: Wix websites Landing pages Website redesign projects User experience improvements AI-assisted web projects (if applicable) Please clearly explain your role and contributions to each project. 3. Short Introduction Video (2–3 Minutes) Please answer: Tell us about yourself. What interests you about this role? What website platforms do you work with? What AI tools do you currently use? What makes you different from other applicants? 4. Website Review Exercise After reviewing our website and digital presence, please provide: Three recommendations to improve user experience. Three recommendations to improve audience engagement. One recommendation that would have the greatest impact on our business. A brief explanation for each recommendation. We are interested not only in your technical skills, but also in your ability to understand audiences, think strategically, and contribute meaningful ideas.

title: Short-Term Rental Pricing Strategist & Operations Manager
job_title: Short-Term Rental Pricing Strategist & Operations Manager
description: We are a family-owned short-term rental business based in Northern Greece (Thessaloniki coast). We operate 2 beachfront apartments in the Thessaloniki area of Northern Greece, both connected on ---------- with 9.8+ guest review scores. We are launching on Airbnb soon. The business is run by a brother-and-sister team — we handle everything on the ground ourselves (guest experience, cleaning, check-ins, maintenance). What we are missing is someone with real strategic expertise who can build our pricing strategy AND make sure the day-to-day operations behind the scenes run smoothly. We are not a corporation. We are a family that takes pride in our properties and our guests. We are looking for someone who treats this like a partnership, not just a task list. If you are the kind of person who genuinely enjoys figuring out why one listing outperforms another and what to do about it — and who also gets satisfaction from knowing the numbers are accurate and the calendar is tight — you will enjoy working with us. ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT This role has two phases: Phase 1 — Setup, Strategy Build & Systems Check (First 10–20 days) This phase will be heavier in hours (15–20 hours/week). During this time, you will audit our full ---------- setup, conduct deep competitor research, review our current pricing and rate structure, and deliver a complete pricing strategy and operational recommendations for both apartments. You will also check that our ---------- infrastructure is solid — extranet settings, rate plans, calendar configuration, payment setup, promotion structure, cancellation policies, and anything else that needs to be cleaned up or optimized. You will learn our P&L tracking system and begin logging reservation data accurately. Both apartments are connected on ---------- , so you need to understand how multi-property setups work. Phase 2 — Ongoing Summer Operations (4 months: June–September) If the strategy you deliver in Phase 1 is strong and we work well together, you stay on as our Apartment Pricing, Strategy & Operations Manager for the full summer season. During this phase, hours will be 10–15 per week depending on the needs. You will own weekly competitor monitoring, rate adjustments, performance reporting, calendar management, P&L tracking, and ongoing strategic recommendations. Peak summer in our area is intense — high demand, fast-moving competitor pricing, and every night counts. We need someone who stays sharp throughout and keeps the machine running behind the scenes. WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR This role is for someone who has spent at least 2 years inside the ---------- and/or Airbnb ecosystem from the host or property management side. Someone who already knows how discount stacking works, how Genius and mobile rates affect visibility, how to read the Booking extranet analytics, and how to build a pricing strategy that balances occupancy with profit. Someone who can look at 10 competitor listings and tell us exactly where we stand and what to do about it. And someone who understands that strategy means nothing if the calendar has errors, the P&L is wrong, or a reservation falls through the cracks. We do not need ideas on a whiteboard. We need someone who turns expertise into action — specific rate recommendations, specific changes to our extranet, specific moves based on what competitors are doing this week — while also making sure the operational foundation underneath is solid and accurate. WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR This is NOT a general virtual assistant position. We are not looking for someone to only answer guest messages or do basic admin. This is NOT for someone who has only managed social media or written listing descriptions. We need analytical thinking and operational precision, not copywriting. This is NOT for someone who will wait for us to tell them what to do. We need someone who brings the plan to us and keeps the business running proactively. This is NOT for beginners who want to "learn about short-term rentals." We need proven hands-on experience. If you cannot explain the difference between effective discount percentage and nominal discount percentage, or you have never built a competitor pricing comparison, or you have never maintained a financial tracker for a rental property, this role is not the right fit. WHAT YOU WILL OWN ---------- Infrastructure Audit & Setup Review our full ---------- extranet setup for both connected apartments Check and optimize: rate plans, room configuration, cancellation policies, payment settings, promotion structure, Genius and mobile rate setup, calendar accuracy, content completeness Identify anything that is misconfigured, missing, or hurting our visibility and conversion Deliver a clear list of fixes with priority order and implement them (or guide us through implementation) Competitor Research & Market Intelligence Identify and track our top 10–12 competitors in the Perea / Neoi Epivates / Thessaloniki coast area Build and maintain a competitor tracking report: nightly rates (weekday/weekend/seasonal), discount strategies, review scores, listing quality, amenities, occupancy patterns Update this research weekly and deliver a brief written summary of what changed and what it means for us Monitor new listings entering our market and flag any threats Pricing Strategy & Rate Architecture Develop a full pricing plan for both apartments across the year: peak season, shoulder season, off-season, holidays, weekends Recommend our base nightly rates, discount structure (Genius, mobile, non-refundable, weekly, monthly), and minimum stay rules Advise on when to activate or pause specific promotions and rate plans Analyze how our current pricing is performing — are we leaving money on the table or pricing ourselves out? Deliver a monthly pricing review with clear, actionable recommendations P&L Tracking & Financial Operations Log every reservation into our P&L tracking spreadsheet accurately and completely (we have a detailed model already built with Greek tax logic — environmental fee, city tax, VAT, commission, bank charges, utilities, cleaning, maintenance reserve, and income tax) Ensure the numbers match what ---------- and Airbnb report — no discrepancies, no missing reservations Track net profit per reservation and per night for each apartment separately Maintain the monthly summary and year-to-date financial view Flag any reservation where the net profit falls below our minimum target so we can investigate and adjust Deliver a clean, accurate monthly P&L report for each apartment and combined Calendar & Booking Operations Keep the ---------- and Airbnb calendars accurate and synchronized at all times — zero double bookings Review upcoming reservations weekly: confirm dates are correct, rates match our strategy, no conflicts or errors Flag check-in/check-out overlaps that could create turnover problems (e.g., same-day checkout and check-in with no cleaning window) Monitor for cancellations and immediately flag freed-up dates so we can adjust pricing to resell them Ensure the overall apartment management flow runs smoothly from a systems perspective — if something is broken or inefficient in the booking pipeline, we expect you to catch it and raise it Revenue Reporting & Performance Tracking Track our key metrics: ADR, occupancy rate, net revenue per night, effective discount %, commission impact Flag occupancy gaps early and recommend tactical rate adjustments to fill them Provide a monthly performance report comparing our actual results to competitor benchmarks and to our own targets Strategic Advisory Deliver a 90-day pricing roadmap based on your initial competitor research and market analysis Recommend which ---------- programs and promotions are worth participating in and which are not Advise on our Airbnb launch pricing strategy Identify opportunities we are missing — country rates, early-bird discounts, last-minute deals, minimum stay optimization WHAT WE PROVIDE Full access to our ---------- extranet and Airbnb dashboard A detailed competitor research spreadsheet template (ready to use) A complete financial P&L model with Greek tax logic built in (you do not need to build it — you need to maintain it accurately) A revenue calculator that models discount stacking, commission, and net profit Owners who are engaged, responsive, and act fast on good recommendations A family business environment where your work has direct, visible impact GROWTH OPPORTUNITY We want to be transparent about what this could become. If this engagement goes well over the summer, there is a real opportunity to grow beyond our two apartments. We are connected with other property owners in the same area who are interested in professional pricing, strategy, and operations support for their own ---------- listings. We would be happy to introduce you and help you build a client base in our market. The right person could turn this into a steady, multi-property engagement across the Thessaloniki coast. But first, let us see what you can do with our two. REQUIREMENTS Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with ---------- and/or Airbnb from the host, co-host, or property management side You have personally set up or managed rate plans, promotions, and pricing strategies (not just guest messaging) You have maintained financial records, P&L tracking, or revenue reporting for rental properties Strong analytical skills — you are comfortable with spreadsheets, data, and numbers Detail-oriented and accurate — our P&L model has precise tax calculations and we need the data entered correctly You can write a clear, concise report in English that a non-technical person can understand and act on Reliable internet and availability to overlap with European time zone (CET) for regular check-ins PREFERRED Experience with PriceLabs, Beyond Pricing, Wheelhouse, or AirDNA Experience with European or Mediterranean short-term rental markets Understanding of OTA commission structures and how they affect net revenue Experience managing pricing and operations across multiple connected properties on ---------- Experience with multi-platform calendar synchronization WHAT WE EXPECT Week 1–2: Complete ---------- infrastructure audit and competitor research delivered for both apartments. P&L tracker set up with all existing reservations logged. Week 3–4: Full pricing strategy and rate architecture recommended, with specific numbers and rate plans. Calendars verified and synced. Month 2: Weekly competitor updates and calendar checks running on schedule. P&L tracker accurate and up to date. First monthly performance and financial report delivered. Month 3: Measurable improvement in either ADR, occupancy, or net revenue per night compared to Month 1. Clean financial records with zero discrepancies. HOW TO APPLY Send us: Which ---------- or Airbnb properties you have managed — how many listings, and what was your specific role in pricing, strategy, and operations (not just guest communication or cleaning coordination) One example of a pricing decision you made that improved revenue or occupancy — what did you change, why, and what was the result Have you maintained P&L records or financial tracking for rental properties? If yes, briefly describe what you tracked and how Your availability and expected hourly rate Short, specific answers beat long generic ones. We read every application carefully.

title: Experienced Lead Manager (Real Estate)
description: We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit. Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people. Responsibilities: Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and email . Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell. Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.). Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting. Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us. Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action. Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth. Requirements: Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.) Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know! Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls. Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da ---------- hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team. What We Offer: Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal. Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution. Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. You'll learn about the wholesale home-buying industry, negotiations, and how to evaluate seller motivation. Ongoing coaching will be available to sharpen your skills (we succeed when you succeed). Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them. Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work. How to Apply: If you're excited about nurturing leads and driving deals, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself. In your intro, tell us why you're interested in this Lead Manager role and highlight any relevant experience (especially in real estate or sales). You can use a service like Vocaroo for the recording and share the link. Feel free to also include a brief note or cover letter about a time you successfully convinced a customer or closed a tough deal – we value those who take initiative to showcase their skills. Qualified candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview (and possibly a role-play exercise). Come join a team where your follow-up prowess will be highly valued and rewarded!
