As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit. Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people. Responsibilities: Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and email . Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell. Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.). Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting. Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us. Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action. Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth. Requirements: Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.) Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know! Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them. Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls. Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da ---------- hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team. What We Offer: Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal. Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution. Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them. Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work. Qualified candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview (and possibly a role-play exercise). Come join a team where your follow-up prowess will be highly valued and rewarded!

title: Operations & Project Execution (Fast Growing)
description: Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.” Who This Is NOT For You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence. You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/ You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side. You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first. Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs. You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create. You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth (All of this is written into your contract.) Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial • $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit. • No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors. Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside • Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward. • On top of base, you can earn: $400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them). $1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard. • In practice, that means: Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture. Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay) We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat. We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando ---------- etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls. Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here. How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises) If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are: A short interview focused on your past execution. A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit. Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must: Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list): – “Fix Asana, it’s a mess” – “Seller lead texting follow up??” – “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ” – “Inventory backlog insane” – “Need better reporting” – “Update SOPs In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager. In a Google Doc, please: Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points. Link the Google Doc here (view access). Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying. description: Job Title: Experienced UK Property Sourcer /Sourcing Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (to be discussed) About the Role We are seeking an experienced UK Property Sourcer with a minimum of 2 years’ proven experience sourcing property in the UK market — ideally with exposure to commercial and retail property. This is an opportunity to lead a new venture focused on sourcing retail and mixed-use assets, both on-market and off-market, across key UK cities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the UK property market, commercial property terminology, and deal structuring, with the ability to work independently to identify, qualify, and build a consistent pipeline of property opportunities aligned to our investment criteria. Key Responsibilities Conduct high-volume searches for suitable retail and commercial property opportunities across targeted UK regions. Source both on-market and off-market opportunities through a combination of platforms, agent relationships, and direct outreach. Develop and maintain relationships with commercial agents, property brokers, and landlords. Create and manage a property pipeline of qualified leads that meet the company’s investment and acquisition criteria. Present shortlisted and qualified opportunities to senior management once they reach agreed heads of terms or negotiation stages. Monitor and report on market trends, pricing movements, and geographic variations across the UK. Maintain accurate sourcing records, communications, and deal progress in CRM or other agreed formats. Requirements Minimum 2 years’ experience sourcing property in the UK market (commercial or residential). Demonstrated experience and results in commercial property sourcing strongly preferred. Familiarity with major UK property listing platforms (Rightmove Commercial, EG Propertylink, Realla, CoStar, Zoopla, etc.) and agent networks. Strong understanding of UK geography, particularly key retail and commercial hubs. Working knowledge of commercial property terms, deal structures, and acquisition processes. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, both written and verbal. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple opportunities concurrently. Proactive, self-driven, and target-oriented with a hunger to grow a sourcing division. What We Offer Opportunity to lead and grow a sourcing function from inception. Competitive remuneration and performance-based incentives. Long-term growth potential into a senior leadership role overseeing the sourcing division. Supportive and entrepreneurial environment with direct access to senior decision-makers. To Apply Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining: Your relevant property sourcing experience, including specific UK commercial property examples. Why you believe you are suited to this role and would be the ideal candidate to lead this sourcing venture. Important: Generic or AI-generated responses will be immediately rejected — we’re looking for genuine, experience-based applications only. Property Sourcing Candidate Questions Please include answers to all the following questions in your application: What is your current role and main responsibility? Which countries have you worked in for sourcing or acquiring property? What type (land, residential, commercial)? Was your sourcing experience primarily conducted online, by email , phone, letter, or other methods? Are you sourcing on-market or off-market opportunities? On average, how many properties could you source or put forward per week? Of the properties you sourced, approximately what percentage resulted in completed deals? Have you worked in the UK property market before? If yes, what platforms, tools, or resources do you currently use for sourcing in the UK? Are you available for part-time work (around 10 hours per week)? What is your availability to start, and what hourly rate are you looking for? What are your long-term career goals in property or investment?

title: BIM Structural Modeler (Revit/AU Client)
description: You have spent years sharpening your Revit skills on structural steel projects — producing models that are precise, coordinated, and built to be constructed, not just admired on screen. But if your current role isn't giving you the complexity, the project scale, or the professional recognition that your experience deserves, it may be time to take the next step. About the Company: Go Ignite is partnering with a well-established Australian mechanical services contractor with a strong national presence. Known for delivering complex, design-and-construct projects across multiple sectors, this organisation has built its reputation on precision engineering and a genuine commitment to prefabrication and BIM as core delivery capabilities. Their team culture is collaborative and grounded in long-term thinking — qualities that carry through to how they engage and support their remote staff. About the Role: As a BIM Structural Modeler, you will be the technical backbone of prefabrication and modular steel delivery. Working fully remotely and supporting an Australian team, you will produce the models, drawings, and documentation that take a project from concept to fabrication-ready output. Your work will directly influence how structural steel components are designed, priced, coordinated, and built. You will collaborate closely with Design Managers and BIM Coordinators to ensure models stay accurate, coordinated, and aligned with project deadlines. What You'll Be Doing: Generating and editing structural steel elements in Revit — including main members, bracing, purlins, handrails, mesh grating, connection details, and equipment skids Producing plan, section, isometric, and detailed drawings for prefabricated and modular steel components Creating concept and tender models from engineering sketches and design instructions Developing and managing Revit families specific to prefabrication and modular construction workflows Executing quantity take-offs and scheduling from Revit models for steel, grating, purlins, and handrails Performing clash detection and participating in design coordination reviews Coordinating regularly with the Design Manager and BIM Coordinators to meet deliverables, deadlines, and project budgets What You'll Bring: Minimum 3 years of Revit modelling and drafting experience, specifically in structural steel projects Qualifications in Mechanical or Structural Engineering and/or Drafting Solid understanding of prefabrication and modular construction workflows Familiarity with Australian construction industry terminology and standards Working knowledge of Bluebeam Revu and Microsoft Excel Experience with Tekla Structures or Autodesk Inventor is a strong advantage Strong attention to detail, clear English communication, and a track record of delivering quality output on time Why This Opportunity Is Different: This is a long-term, fully remote engagement with a company that treats BIM and prefabrication as a strategic advantage — not an afterthought. You will work on landmark-scale projects alongside experienced engineers and coordinators, in a team culture built on respect and collaboration. For a skilled Revit modeler ready to work at the standard that tier-one Australian construction demands, this is the kind of role that builds a career. Compensation and Benefits: PHP 45,000–60,000 per month Fully remote setup Paid Time Off + Prepaid HMO coverage Performance bonus Weekends off, dayshift hours Ready to Apply? Send your updated CV and portfolio or work samples together with your answers for the below questions: 1. How many years have you been using Revit specifically for structural steel modelling? Describe the types of steel elements you have modelled — for example, main members, bracing, purlins, handrails, or connection details. 2. Have you worked on prefabricated or modular construction projects? If yes, describe your role in the process — from model creation through to drawing production and coordination with fabrication or site teams. 3. How familiar are you with Australian construction industry terminology and standards? Have you previously supported an Australian client or worked on projects following Australian specifications? Please give a specific example if applicable. 4. Which of the following tools have you used professionally, and at what level of proficiency — Revit, Tekla Structures, Autodesk Inventor, and Bluebeam Revu? Please rate yourself (Basic / Intermediate / Advanced) for each tool you have used.

description: Job Summary: We are seeking an analytical, process-driven Strategic Project Manager to act as the primary gatekeeper and operational architect for our upcoming initiatives. In this role, you will evaluate incoming opportunities in the EV charging station and vehicle inspection spaces, analyzing them against our strategic goals and past performance to determine viability ("Should we pursue this project?"). You won't just manage timelines—you will be responsible for deconstructing complex project scopes, identifying technical and utility requirements, reviewing or creating winning commercial proposals, and designing step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The ideal candidate combines a background in technical project management (infrastructure, utilities, or fleet operations) with a rigorous approach to process standardisation. Key Responsibilities: 1. Project Evaluation & Feasibility Analysis (Go/No-Go) Critically evaluate new project leads for charging station installations and vehicle inspection programs to assess financial profitability, technical viability, and operational capacity. Review prospective station sites or fleet sizes against our historical data to advise leadership on whether a project makes strategic sense to pursue. Factor in variables like utility grid capacity, local zoning laws, inspection volume, and regional compliance factors during initial evaluation phases. 2. Technical Scope Breakdown & Requirements Gathering Deconstruct high-level project requests into highly technical, executable project scopes. Map out exact requirements for EV charging deployment (e.g., electrical load demands, transformer upgrades, hardware/software interoperability, ADA compliance). Identify exact criteria for vehicle inspection setups (e.g., diagnostic tool integration, physical lane layouts, safety testing compliance, data management systems). Pinpoint project bottlenecks, supply chain constraints (hardware lead times), and permitting risks early on. 3. Proposal Creation & Review Draft thorough, professional project proposals, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs) for clients, municipal entities, or enterprise fleet partners. Conduct strict reviews of internally created proposals to ensure cost estimates, deployment timelines, and resource allocations are realistic and protect the company from scope creep. 4. Process Optimization & SOP Development Build out a library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for newly approved projects to ensure seamless, highly repeatable field execution. Author SOPs for charging station installation, site commissioning, safety testing, and post-install maintenance. Create standardized workflows, inspection checklists, and software training SOPs for vehicle inspection technicians to ensure quality control and regulatory compliance. Qualifications & Experience: Experience: 4+ years of project management or operations management experience, specifically within EV charging infrastructure, civil/electrical construction, fleet management, or automotive service/inspection programs. Analytical Assessment: Strong ability to read technical site plans, utility sheets, or fleet specifications and make data-driven decisions on project feasibility. Documentation Excellence: Proven track record of drafting complex proposals, SOWs, and creating highly structured, clear SOPs for technical workflows. Regulatory/Technical Knowledge: * Familiarity with EV charging infrastructure (Level 2 & DC Fast Charging, utility interconnection, permitting). Familiarity with automotive/vehicle inspection standards, diagnostic equipment, or compliance regulations is a major asset. Tools: Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp, Asana, Jira, Monday.com) and visual process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro). Certification: PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or CAPM is highly preferred. Who You Are: The Strategic Gatekeeper: You know how to look past the excitement of a new deal and evaluate whether it actually makes financial and operational sense for the team to execute. Detail-Obsessed: You care about the nuance of a utility grid connection or the exact calibration steps of a vehicle inspection tool, ensuring no detail is missed in the scope. A Process Creator: You thrive on turning a chaotic, "one-off" project execution into a repeatable, step-by-step SOP system that anyone on the team can follow. An Effective Communicator: You can easily align utility companies, electrical contractors, inspection technicians, and executive stakeholders on a singular vision.

title: YOUTUBE STRATEGIST/ CHANNEL MANAGER
description: Market Leaders' socials - study before applying: ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Most "YouTube manager" roles are upload monkeys. You're handed a finished video, you slap on a title someone else wrote, you publish, you log off. Market Leaders doesn't work that way. We have the cameras, the editors, and the founders who know the material cold. What we don't have is one person who owns the **thinking** — the person who d ---------- what we make, why anyone would click, and whether the channel actually grows. That's you. You are not here to edit. You are here to run the engine. You plan the slate with the team, you brief the people who shoot and edit, you write the titles and direct the thumbnails that d ---------- whether a video lives or dies, and you read the analytics like a scoreboard. If you've grown a channel before and you think in CTR, retention, and packaging — not just in pretty cuts — read on. This is a fully remote role for someone who wants to own a number, not wait for instructions. ABOUT MARKET LEADERS Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators — property agents doing $500M+ in deals, financial advisors with established ad systems, business owners building real personal brands — turn their expertise into content that compounds. We teach the 5 C's: Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client. We believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable. World-class, no compromise. This role is for **our own channels** — the Market Leaders brand channel plus our founders' long-form. You're building the flagship that proves what we teach. The bar is set. TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE **Base Salary:** SGD $2,000/month **What's Included** - Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT) - Direct line to the founders and the content team you'll be directing - Market Leaders training on hooks, packaging, retention, and short-form/long-form strategy - The tools you need to do the job (analytics, scheduling, thumbnail collaboration, AI ideation) - Ownership of a real channel's growth number — not a faceless task queue **Work Benefits** - Results-focused, not clock-watching — we judge the channel's numbers, not your hours online - Clear monthly scoreboard so you always know where you stand - Real budget exposure: your packaging gets tested with real distribution **Path Forward** - Prove you can grow the number, and the scope grows with you — more channels, a bigger team to direct, and a senior content-lead track - This is a long-term seat for the right operator, not a gig THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN ### 1. ROLE — The Mission Own Market Leaders' long-form YouTube engine end to end. You plan what we make, you direct the team that films and edits it, you package it so people click and stay, and you grow the channel on the strength of the analytics. You are the brain of the operation — the editors are the hands. Every video serves a business objective: - Position Market Leaders and our founders as the trusted authority in their space - Earn the click (title + thumbnail) and hold the watch (structure + pacing) - Turn our frameworks and founder insight into long-form people actually finish - Feed the short-form machine — every long-form becomes Shorts and cross-platform clips You will use AI to ideate and research faster, but the taste and the calls are yours. ### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work **Strategy & Ideation — 30%** - Plan the monthly long-form slate *with the team* — what we make, in what order, and why - Research topics, search demand, and competitor channels to find angles worth filming - Turn founder material and frameworks into clear briefs and outlines the team can shoot - Bring a point of view to every video: who it's for, the hook, the payoff **Packaging — Titles & Thumbnails — 25%** - Write multiple title options per video and test them — this is the single biggest CTR lever - Direct thumbnail concepts (brief the designer; you own the concept, not the Photoshop) - Own click-through rate as a metric you're personally accountable for - Keep a swipe file of what's working and feed it back into the next slate **Production Direction — 25%** - Brief the shooters and editors against your outline, then QC the cut against the brief - Run the content calendar and pipeline so videos ship on a predictable cadence - Unblock the team, chase what's stuck, and keep the machine moving - Maintain a repeatable production system, not one-off heroics **Channel Management & Analytics — 20%** - Publish with proper titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end-screens, and playlists - Live in YouTube Studio: read CTR, average view duration, retention curves, and traffic sources - Turn each long-form into Shorts and repurpose across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn - Report the numbers and the next move — what we'll change and why ### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like **Foundation Phase — Month 1** - Know the channels, the founders' voices, and the back catalogue cold - Ship the first slate you planned end to end — briefed, filmed, edited, packaged, published - Stand up a working content calendar and a titles/thumbnails packaging system - Establish the baseline: current CTR, AVD, and retention, so we know what we're improving *This phase is about learning the brand, the material, and the team rhythm.* **Growth Phase — Month 3** - Hold a consistent publishing cadence with no missed weeks - Show a measurable lift in CTR and/or average view duration vs. baseline - Run a repeatable packaging system the team can follow without you in every detail - Reliably turn each long-form into Shorts and cross-platform clips *This phase is where you stop reacting and start driving the channel.* **Long-Term Impact — Month 6** - Own the channel number — views, subscribers, retention — with minimal founder input - Direct the team to ship the slate on cadence while you stay focused on strategy + packaging - Demonstrate channel growth attributable to your packaging and slate decisions - Be trusted to take on more channels and a bigger team *This phase is where the channel runs as a system you own, not a series of one-offs.* ### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves **Experience** - Demonstrable track record growing a YouTube channel (yours or a client's) — show the before/after - Hands-on experience writing and testing titles and directing thumbnails for CTR - Experience directing a remote content team (editors, designers, shooters) against briefs - Strong grasp of long-form structure, hooks, and retention — and how Shorts feed the main channel **Skills** - Fluent in YouTube Studio analytics — CTR, AVD, retention, traffic sources, and what to do about each - Comfortable using AI tools for ideation, research, scripting support, and repurposing - Strong written and spoken English — you'll be briefing a team and the founders daily - Comfortable with a project-management tool (Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or similar) **Work Arrangement** - Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for briefs and reviews - Reliable laptop and internet — you run the pipeline, you can't drop offline - Able to commit long-term, not a short gig between other things **Work Style** - Ownership mentality — you treat the channel's growth like your own business - Self-managed — nobody is going to watch over your shoulder; the numbers do that - Decisive on packaging — you form opinions and test them, you don't wait to be told - Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "this missed" than "this is fine" WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT **You Think in Numbers, Not Just Aesthetics** You don't ask "is the video done?" You ask "will this title earn the click, and will the first 30 seconds keep them?" CTR and retention are your scoreboard. **You've Actually Grown a Channel** You can point to a channel you moved — views, subs, watch time — and explain *why* it grew. You know the difference between a video that got lucky and a system that compounds. **You Direct Without Doing It All Yourself** You're comfortable handing the camera and the timeline to the team and getting what you wanted through a clear brief and honest QC. You scale through people, not through your own keyboard. **You Live in the Packaging** You have opinions on titles and thumbnails. You can look at any channel and explain what you'd change to lift the click. You collect what works. **You Use AI to Move Faster** You're not scared of AI. You use it to research, ideate, and repurpose faster — and you know it sharpens your taste, it doesn't replace it. **You Communicate Proactively** A remote team only works if you flag things early. If footage is weak, you say so. If the slate's slipping, you raise it before it's a problem. **You Crave Improvement** You don't take a flat video personally. You read the retention graph, find the drop-off, and fix it next time. HOW TO APPLY **1. Email ** Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: **YouTube Strategist — [Your Name]** **2. Include These 3 Things** **Channel Proof** - Link to a YouTube channel you've grown or managed, with rough before/after numbers (views, subs, watch time) - 2-3 examples of titles + thumbnails you packaged, and what the CTR did - Optional but useful: an example where you used AI in your workflow **Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences** > *"Pick one YouTube channel in the business, finance, property, or coaching space that you think is packaged well. Name 3 things they do well that most channels in their niche do badly — and 1 thing you would change about their titles or thumbnails to lift the click. Be specific. Point to actual videos."* This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for strategic thinking, not just upload skills. Generic feedback = skipped application. **Resume/CV** PDF format only. **3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted** We'll give you Market Leaders' positioning and one topic. You'll deliver a 30-day mini content plan: - 5 long-form video concepts, each with 3 title options and a thumbnail direction - One full video outline (hook ? structure ? payoff ? CTA) - A short plan for repurposing that video into Shorts and cross-platform clips - Turnaround: 72 hours from receipt of the brief - Paid regardless of outcome The trial isn't testing whether you can fill a template. It's testing whether you can think like a channel owner — pick angles that earn clicks, structure for retention, and run a system. **4. Interview** - 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team - A short live packaging exercise — we hand you a topic, you talk us through titles and thumbnail angles - Decision before offer

title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
job_title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
description: ## About us, in plain terms Blue Harbour ( ---------- )  helps large infrastructure organisations achieve **capital certainty** — a clear, governed, trustworthy view of where their capital programmes stand and the decisions behind them. We use AI to deliver that with a speed and diligence traditional consulting can't match: what used to take a consulting team weeks, we turn around fast and well. We're already live with our first major client in New Zealand, opening in Australia next, and built to expand into new markets after that. AI is *how we work*, not what we sell. We sell certainty; AI is our edge in producing it. We're hiring our **first operator** — the person who runs the commercial engine of the business so it keeps running and replicating into new markets. ## The role in one line Run the commercial machine end-to-end — the product-and-knowledge engine that turns delivered work into reusable assets, the business-development pipeline, the executive backbone, and research — with the judgment to know what to handle and what to escalate. ## What you'll actually do - **Run the product-and-knowledge engine — this is the heart of the role.** We turn every piece of delivered work into reusable, sellable product: the features, methods and analysis built for one client become the templates, modules and playbooks we deploy for the next. We run a structured, AI-operated "second brain" that several people contribute to, and it's already built. Your job is to keep it coherent *and* to drive the loop that converts one-off delivery into canonical, reusable assets — enforce the conventions, keep the canonical material clean and current, turn finished work into templates, and make the repeatable version of what we do one of our most valuable assets. You steward and systematise against the founder's "what good looks like"; you don't have to author the product judgment, you have to capture and compound it. - **Run the growth pipeline — Australia next.** Research and qualify the organisations we'd work with as we open a new market — whether we partner to sell and deliver, or go direct — keep the CRM current, and draft the outreach and pitches. You run the funnel right up to the close; the founder holds the relationships and closes. As you go, you help capture *how* it's done — the repeatable version of "find and win the next market" is itself one of the assets we're building. - **Hold the executive backbone.** Inbox, calendar, follow-up, focus protection. Nothing drops. - **Build the pipeline of high-value rooms and relationships.** Research and organise the events, forums, and introductions that grow our network in target markets. You handle the research and logistics; the founder handles the relationships once he's in the room. - **Run onboarding for new tea ---------- mbers.** As we bring on technical and delivery people, you run the onboarding scaffolding — training flow, a guided path through the system, the day-to-day "where does this live" — so they get productive without the founder running it. (You're building the scaffolding a future delivery team will run.) - **Draft offers of service** from a brief to ~70% off our template library; the founder takes them the rest of the way. - **Run market and competitive research** — pricing, positioning, landscape, and which market to open next — delivered as a clear, decision-useful read with sources, not a pile of links. You'll use AI throughout — the same way the business does, as the tool that makes the work fast and thorough. Day one, that means using AI with judgment to do real work; over time, you'll grow into genuinely running an AI-operated company, a skill that compounds and that almost no one has yet. ## What you get - **USD 2,000–3,000/month**, depending on experience. This is a **full-time, single-client role**, and we pay a fair full-time rate specifically so you don't need a second client splitting your focus. The pay and the single-client commitment are two halves of the same deal. - **Benefits from day one:** private health cover (HMO), a 13th-month equivalent, paid leave, and an equipment/internet allowance. We're hiring for the long term and we structure the role that way. - **A provided AI tooling seat.** - **Real growth without having to leave to get it.** You'll become fluent in running an AI-native operation — a rare and rising skill — and the role's scope deepens as the business opens new markets. - **Stability.** This is a long-term seat at a growing business, not a project or a stop-gap. We're looking for someone who wants one solid, high-trust role for years, not the next rung. ## Ramp & hours - Part-time for the first 6–8 weeks while you learn the system, **paid as a fixed monthly retainer** (not pro-rata), then full rate once you're up to speed — sooner if you're ready. - Remote, with a **minimum 4 hours' daily overlap with New Zealand business hours** (Manila daytime — no night shifts). When in your day the rest of the work happens is flexible; the overlap and "nothing drops" are not. ## Who this is for If you've run an operation end-to-end and been trusted with the whole picture before, you'll recognize this role. We're looking for someone who: - leads with **judgment** — knows what to handle, what to escalate, and what to push back on; - turns **one-offs into reusable assets** — instinctively makes the second version a template, not another from-scratch job, and can tell what's reusable from what's client-specific; - thinks in **systems and conventions** — can keep a shared system coherent as more people use it, without bottlenecking everything through themselves; - **finishes** — work arrives done and self-checked, not at 80%-and-back-to-you; - writes **clearly and fast**, and can hold someone else's voice; - uses **AI with judgment** — knows when to trust it, when not to, and when to do it by hand; - is **discreet by instinct**, not just when told; - wants a **long-term, single-client seat** and the security that comes with it. This is a high-responsibility, high-ownership role. The right person is bracing for that — for owning outcomes and holding the line on what matters — not for anything else.

title: Property Deal Analyst - Full Time
description: We're a UK property company. We find rental property deals, analyse them, and either manage them ourselves or pass them to investors. There's a steady flow of potential deals coming in every day, and someone needs to go through them properly and tell us which ones are worth our time. It's careful, focused, repetitive work - and done well, it's one of the most important roles in the business, because everything we do starts with finding good deals and filtering out bad ones. We're looking for someone who is genuinely good at careful, detailed analysis, takes pride in getting it right, and wants a stable role they can settle into for the long term. Every day, you will: Find potential deals : Search specific Facebook groups and other online sources where property deals get posted. Filter them (first pass): Run each one against a clear set of pass/fail rules we'll give you. Most deals fail here - that's normal and correct. Your job is to kill the obvious "no" deals quickly so they never reach us. Analyse the survivors (deep dive): For the deals that pass the first filter, you'll do a proper analysis: pull the numbers, find comparable properties, check the competition, and fill out a deal analysis sheet we'll provide. Give a verdict: For each analysed deal, you'll give us a clear thumbs up or thumbs down - "this is a good deal" or "this isn't" - with your reasoning. We make the final call, but your verdict is what we act on, so it has to be sound. Keep everything organised: Log each deal in our system so nothing slips through the cracks. You will not be talking to landlords, negotiating, or closing deals. That's our side. Your job is the analysis and the verdict - and doing it accurately, every day, at good volume. You'll do well here if you: Can form a sound judgement on numbers. This is the heart of the job. You'll be d ---------- whether a deal is actually good, and we act on your verdict. We need someone who can look at the figures and think clearly about whether they really stack up - who can tell a genuinely good deal from one that's just been dressed up to look good. This is not copy-and-paste data entry. Stay consistent, so deal number 40 gets the same care as deal number 1. You don't get sloppy when you're tired or bored. You hit your daily targets without being chased, and a cleared list done correctly gives you genuine satisfaction. Catch the small things. A wrong comparable, a transposed number, a missing field - you notice it. In this work, small errors lead to wrong verdicts, so getting the details right the first time matters. Want this role for the long term. You're looking for a stable, steady job you can hold for years - not a stepping stone to something else. Have reliable power and internet. This work happens on a daily schedule, so you need a stable setup where you can work consistently without long outages. Please don't apply if you: Are looking for a short-term gig or a stepping stone while you pursue something else - studying full-time, planning to move abroad, building your own business on the side. This role needs your full focus and a long-term commitment. Get bored easily by repetitive, detail-heavy work. This job is the same careful process every day. If that sounds dull to you, you'll be unhappy here and so will we. You do not need any property or real estate experience - we'll train you on everything property-related. We're hiring for temperament and analytical ability, not property knowledge. How to apply There's a link below to complete the application form for this role. This is the only way your application will be processed. You'll also need to attach a short Loom video of yourself within the application form, introducing yourself further. title: Ready to Help Build a Luxury LGBT Real Estate Brand in Charlotte, NC? Let's Grow Together.
job_title: Ready to Help Build a Luxury LGBT Real Estate Brand in Charlotte, NC? Let's Grow Together.
description: Who We Are Jonathan Winn Real Estate is a Charlotte, NC-based real estate practice built on three non-negotiables: concierge-level client service, high-impact property marketing and a relentless commitment to growth.  We do not do average. Our clients are buying and selling some of the most significant assets of their lives, and they deserve to feel that every step of the process is handled with care, expertise, and intention. We market our listings like a luxury brand. We treat our clients like family. And we show up every single day looking for the next person we can serve. We are proudly LGBT-owned and deeply embedded in the LGBT real estate community through the KW Rainbow Network and our local LGBT community in Charlotte. Our brand reflects our values which are authenticity, inclusion, and doing right by people in everything we do.  We always do the right thing, even when no one is looking. This is not a job for someone who wants to clock in and clock out. This is a role for someone who is genuinely excited about building a business, who takes initiative without being asked, who sees opportunities before they become obvious, and who understands that their fingerprints will be all over the growth of this company. If you have experience in real estate sales operations and you know what it takes to grow a real estate business, we want to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a sharp, experienced, and growth-minded Virtual Operations and Marketing Coordinator to run the systems that keep our pipeline full, our clients cared for, and our brand visible.  And in everything that we do, help us identify new opportunities to grow and generate more clients to serve. This is a full-time role with real responsibility. You will not just execute tasks. You will be expected to assess our current operations, spot gaps and opportunities, and bring ideas and solutions to the table proactively. The right person will become an indispensable strategic partner in growing this business. This role has a clear path to team leadership as the business scales. Your Responsibilities will include: CRM & Database Management (Follow Up Boss) - Organize, clean, and maintain our contact database - Input new contacts and business cards into FUB and create corresponding vCard files - Tag leads correctly and flag daily follow-up opportunities each morning - Prepare a daily "who to reach out to today" priority list for Jonathan Add new KW Rainbow Network members, enroll them in a welcome sequence, and invite them to connect with Jonathan via calendar booking link - Build, manage, and continuously improve action plans and automations for all of our target audiences, including prospects, other real estate agents, current active clients, clients who have closed business with us, and more. Email Newsletters - Draft and send our monthly sphere newsletter using Jonathan's brand voice - Draft and send our monthly agent referral newsletter to approximately 2,500 real estate agents nationwide - Support re-engagement campaigns for dormant client lists - Proactively suggest newsletter content, subject lines, and improvements based on what is working Direct Mail & Farm Marketing - Coordinate monthly mailers across three farm lists via Wise Pelican or similar mail service - Rotate mailer formats monthly to keep outreach fresh and engaging - Maintain, clean, and grow all farm address lists Social Media & Brand - Schedule and post to Instagram, Facebook , and LinkedIn on a consistent cadence - Keep website up-to-do with monthly blog posts that are relevant - Design on-brand graphics in Canva using our brand kit - Set up and maintain our brand kit in Canva - Monitor social performance and proactively suggest content improvements - Support the creation and launch of a Youtube channel Client Experience Communications - Build and maintain a milestone communication library for every stage of a transaction - Manage a past client nurture schedule including monthly touches, anniversaries, and holiday outreach - Send review requests after every closing and actively manage our online reputation - Identify gaps in the client experience and recommend improvements Market Intelligence & Content Research - Deliver a weekly brief covering Charlotte events, neighborhood market activity, listing trends, and content ideas for YouTube and social media - Track listing activity and market trends in our farm areas so Jonathan always has fresh talking points - Research competitor agents and identify opportunities to differentiate our brand RealScout Management - Set up, edit, pause, and manage client property searches - Add home value alerts after closing Business Growth & Strategy - Assess our current operations and proactively identify bottlenecks, missed opportunities, and areas for improvement - Bring one idea per week for growing the pipeline, improving client experience, or strengthening the brand - Track key business metrics and flag trends Jonathan should know about - Help build systems and processes that scale as the team grows Required Skills and Experience: To qualify for this role you will need at least 2 years of experience in the following: - Real estate operations, transaction support, or real estate sales marketing -- you must understand how a real estate business grows - CRM management --> Follow Up Boss experience is a strong plus - Email newsletter creation and database management - Social media posting, scheduling, and performance monitoring - Canva design using brand templates Who You Are (Soft Skills) This role is for someone who is genuinely wired for growth. You will thrive here if you are: - A self-starter and initiative-taker --> you do not wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen - Growth minded --> you understand that feeding the pipeline is everyone's job, not just the agent's, and you actively look for ways to help the business grow - A strategic thinker --> you can zoom out, assess a business, and bring insights and recommendations, not just completed tasks - A proactive communicator --> you flag issues before they become problems and bring solutions, not just questions - Detail-oriented --> nothing slips through without you catching it first - Reliable and independent --> you can work autonomously across a 12-plus hour time difference without daily hand-holding - Genuinely aligned with and proud to represent an LGBT-owned, community-rooted luxury real estate brand Basic Technical Requirements In addition to excellent written English you will need to be comfortable with the following tools: - Follow Up Boss (CRM) - Wise Pelican (or similar direct mail system) - RealScout (property search management) - Canva (graphic design) - Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) - Instagram, Facebook , LinkedIn - Slack (daily communication) - Creating and managing a Trello or Asana task management system - Zoom or Google Meet (weekly check-in) Desired Skills (Nice to Have but Not Required) If you have the following skills they will give you a significant advantage: - Prior experience building CRM action plans, automations, or drip campaign sequences - Experience analyzing real estate business metrics and making growth recommendations - YouTube content planning or video coordination experience - Experience managing or training other virtual assistants Work Schedule and Holidays - This is a full-time position at 40 hours per week. - Hours are flexible but you must have consistent availability that overlaps with US Eastern Time business hours. Daily morning or afternoon overlap with Charlotte, NC business hours is required -- not optional. - We honor most Filipino national holidays. Specific holidays will be discussed and agreed upon at the start of employment. Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable) - A reliable, up-to-date computer capable of running Follow Up Boss, Canva, Google Workspace, and social media platforms simultaneously - Fast, stable internet connection with a minimum of 10 Mbps -- please include your speed test result in your application - Quiet, dedicated workspace for daily communication and weekly Zoom calls Salary and Compensation - Base salary: $400/week ($1,600/month), full-time - Performance bonus: $100 for every real estate transaction that closes while you are part of the team. This is not a gift --> it is a recognition that your work in keeping the pipeline warm, the database clean, and the marketing consistent directly contributes to every closed deal. When Jonathan wins, you win.  This is a Winn-Winn. Perks and Benefits After successfully completing your 3-month probationary period with clear 30, 60, and 90-day performance metrics met, you will be eligible for: - 13th month bonus - $100 closing bonus per transaction (effective immediately upon hire for all new under contract transactions) - Path to increased base compensation as the business grows - Opportunity to grow into a team lead role managing other virtual staff Training Provided You will receive full onboarding training on our tools, systems, brand voice, and workflows including Loom video walkthroughs and a structured Week 1 onboarding plan. We invest in the people who invest in us. That said , we are also looking for someone who can look at what we have and tell us what we are missing. The best candidate will come in curious, ask smart questions, and start contributing ideas from day one. Career Potential - This role is designed to grow with the business. As Jonathan scales toward building a full team and stepping into a rainmaker leadership role, the right person in this position will grow into a Director of Virtual Operations who manages other VAs, owning systems, and playing a key role in the expansion of the business. - We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for someone to help build something. How to Apply We review every application personally. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please send all six of the following and use the subject line: "I'm Your Winn-Winn VA" 1. Your resume or work history with real estate experience clearly highlighted 2. A short paragraph in your own words -- no templates, no copy-paste or AI generated responses -- explaining why you are the right fit for this specific role and this specific brand 3. Your Follow Up Boss experience level: none, beginner, intermediate, or advanced 4. One example of a time you helped a business grow including what did you do, what was the result, and how did you know it was working 5. Your computer specs and internet speed in Mbps (please include a speed test screenshot if possible) 6. Your available working hours and how they overlap with US Eastern Time

title: Short Term Rental Virtual Assistant
description: **UPDATE** : Your application will not be considered without prior short term rental industry experience. Airbnb support ambassador experience is definitely favored but certainly not required. Role Summary This role supports daily operations for a short-term rental management business. It requires organization, precision, accuracy, and strong time management. While there may be occasional slow periods, this is not a “chill” job. The company’s reputation is at stake in every guest interaction, message, and phone call. This position is for someone who can operate autonomously, think critically, and consistently protect the guest experience to earn 5-star reviews. Availibility We are looking to have a shift from 4pm to 8pm PST and possibly later. Monday and Friday. We are also looking for a shift 10am to 7pm PST on Saturday and Sunday Compensation Compensation will start at $3 an hour during the probationary period. Upon official acceptance into our company, we will raise you to $3.5 an hour. If performance is spectacular/extarordinary the rate can be raised immediately to $4 an hour. Performance will be assessed again in 6-12 months for an additional raise. We do this to promote a culture of excellence and really compensate for good performance. Our business requires we provide 100% of our efforts to making the guest experience wonderful and our tea ---------- mbers must exemplify that. Core Responsibilities 1) Guest Messaging + Customer Service (Primary) Monitor and respond to guest inquiries and active-stay messages with a professional, upbeat tone. Create real human interactions through the app—guests should feel supported, not automated. De-escalate issues calmly, set expectations, and drive solutions that protect guest satisfaction and reviews. Prioritize messages correctly (urgent vs. non-urgent) and escalate only when required by SOP. 2) Maintenance & Issue Resolution (End-to-End Ownership) You will fully own the maintenance workflow without requiring additional internal staffing or owner attention: Receive guest maintenance requests and immediately log them in our task software with complete details. Schedule the correct maintenance vendor/cleaning tea ---------- mber, confirm availability, and confirm appointment time with the guest. Follow up with maintenance tea ---------- mbers before arrival and ensure they understand requirements. Require photo documentation before/after (or proof of completion) and ensure the task is closed properly. Communicate proactively with guests throughout so the process runs autonomously. Sloppy scheduling, lack of follow-up, and missed coordination will not be tolerated. 3) Phone Calls (Required) Call guests when appropriate (urgent issues, clarifications, service recovery). Call maintenance tea ---------- mbers to schedule, confirm, and resolve issues. Messaging/texting is a large part of the job, but texting-only is not allowed. 4) Message Monitoring Standards (Non-Negotiable) Messages must be checked every 30 minutes during your shift (set an alarm if needed). New inquiries should ideally receive a response within 10 minutes. Ghosting guests for hours is unacceptable. Required Experience Prior work experience supporting Airbnb operations. Supervisor-level experience preferred (or equivalent responsibility managing escalations and team coordination). Strong ability to multitask across multiple conversations, issues, and timelines. Required Skills & Traits Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable with time management. Clear, upbeat, professional communication style (written and verbal). Critical thinking: ability to filter low-importance messages from high-importance issues and act accordingly. Autonomous execution: learns quickly, follows SOPs, and handles issues end-to-end without reminders. Customer-experience mindset: the goal is not just completing tasks—it’s ensuring guests feel cared for and leave 5-star reviews. Tools / Tech Requirements Reliable high-speed internet (required). Comfortable working across Airbnb, task software, and communication tools simultaneously. Ability to maintain organized notes, task logs, and timelines. HOSTAWAY, AIRBNB CHATGPT, GEMINI, ---------- , QUO (openphone) Reliability & Attendance Policy (Strict) No-shows without legitimate, valid reasons will result in immediate termination. Reliability is mandatory. This role directly impacts guest experience and business reputation. Schedule / Coverage Monday - Friday 4pm-8pm PST / Saturday - Sunday 11am to 6pm PST OVERTIME OFFERED Must maintain the 10-minute message-check standard for the full shift. (will change from AI ) How to Apply Please submit: A brief summary of your Airbnb support experience (include number of listings supported and responsibilities). Any supervisor/lead experience (if applicable). Your availability and time zone. A short example of how you would respond (tone + action plan) to: A guest saying Wi-Fi isn’t working, and A guest requesting urgent plumbing help.

description: Airbnb Listing and Pricing Specialist Nestoria Estates is looking for an experienced Airbnb Listing and Pricing Specialist to help manage, optimize, and improve short-term rental listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, ---------- , and Guesty. This role is for someone who already understands short-term rentals, dynamic pricing, listing optimization, Guesty, and OTA performance. This is not an entry-level role. Role Overview The Airbnb Listing and Pricing Specialist will be responsible for creating, updating, auditing, and optimizing property listings, as well as supporting pricing strategy and revenue performance. The goal of this role is to improve listing visibility, booking conversion, occupancy, nightly rates, and overall revenue. Main Responsibilities Create and update short-term rental listings on Airbnb, Vrbo, ---------- , and Guesty. Optimize listing titles, descriptions, amenities, photos, captions, house rules, fees, discounts, and booking settings. Audit listings regularly to make sure all information is accurate, complete, and competitive. Review listing performance, including views, bookings, conversion, occupancy, average daily rate, and revenue. Adjust pricing based on market demand, seasonality, events, occupancy, booking pace, and competitor performance. Work with dynamic pricing tools such as PriceLabs or similar platforms. Review and update minimum nights, discounts, orphan night settings, last-minute pricing, and seasonal rules. Identify underperforming listings and recommend changes to improve results. Check that Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, ---------- , and pricing tools are synced correctly. Monitor calendar issues, pricing errors, restrictions, and availability problems. Support new property launches by setting up listings properly before going live. Create reports or updates on listing performance and recommended actions. Required Experience Guesty experience is required. Airbnb listing management experience is required. Short-term rental pricing experience is required. Experience with PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond, or another dynamic pricing tool is strongly preferred. Experience with Airbnb, Vrbo, and ---------- is strongly preferred. Must understand occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, booking pace, lead time, discounts, minimum nights, and market-based pricing. Must be comfortable reviewing competitor listings and making recommendations. Must be detail-oriented and able to catch errors before listings go live. Must be able to work independently and explain pricing or listing recommendations clearly. Ideal Candidate Has worked for a short-term rental management company before. Understands both listing optimization and revenue management. Knows how to improve bookings without simply lowering prices. Can identify why a listing is not performing. Can work inside Guesty confidently. Can create clear notes, reports, and recommendations. Can follow SOPs but also think critically when something looks wrong. title: Strategic Project Manager
description: This isn’t a typical Project Manager role. WHO WE ARE We're Averus Group,  three healthcare companies (Magnolia Hyperbarics, Cerebral Health, and Pacific Neuroscience Center) in the middle of a transformation. We're building real infrastructure across all three: SOPs, optimized workflows, agentic AI tools — the systems that change how the entire operation runs. The vision is clear and the ceiling is exponential. Right now there's one bottleneck: leadership can only move as fast as it can execute alone. That's where you come in. THE ROLE We need a force multiplier. Someone we can hand a vision to — not a task list — who understands the intent, scopes it, builds it out to completion, and coordinates the people needed to make it real. You're fast. You're independent. You don't need to be walked through every step, and you don't stall the second an instruction isn't spelled out. Your projects could come from any of our three clinics: building an SOP from scratch, streamlining a clinic workflow, standing up an AI process,  and anything in between. You take it, you own it, and you bring back something finished. You don't need to know everything on day one. But you need to learn fast — fast enough to pick up our AI processes, our Claude Cowork environment, and the agentic tools we're building, and then run with them. You think past the task of why it matters and where it should go, and you bring ideas we didn't ask for. You hold the whole picture across three companies and don't lose the thread when we jump from one problem to the next. This seat is senior enough to think and own strategy, and wired to execute on command. If you need a seat in every meeting to feel useful, this isn't it. If you'd rather be handed a hard problem and left alone to solve it — keep reading. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Day-to-day, here's what this looks like. • Take a vision from leadership and build it out to completion — scoping, planning, and delivering finished work • Own projects end to end across all three clinics — SOPs, streamlining, optimization, AI infrastructure • Coordinate and guide the staff needed to put your projects into practice, not just hand off a plan • Build SOPs and drive their adoption in Trainual; train the teams who'll use them • Learn and run with our AI processes, agentic tools, and Claude Cowork environment, fast • Manage multiple projects at once and hold context across entities as priorities shift in real time • Think strategically — bring ideas, improvements, and solutions before they're requested • Work fluently in Notion, Google Workspace, Asana, and Trainual YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF... • Have run projects start to finish on your own; concept to delivery • Are genuinely AI-fluent: you already use modern AI and agentic tools to get real work done • Learn new systems fast and figure things out without a manual • Operate with high ownership — you bring back finished work, not a list of questions • Can coordinate and move other people toward a goal, even ones you don't manage • Think strategically and see around corners, not just the task in front of you • Can hold a lot of moving pieces across multiple businesses without dropping any • Are driven by results and quality, not recognition • Communicate clearly in writing and work cleanly and independently • Can reliably work with the U.S. Pacific business hours Preferred: experience building or supporting AI/automation infrastructure, experience writing SOPs and driving adoption, familiarity with Claude / Claude Cowork and agentic tooling, prior experience supporting a founder or executive directly, and healthcare exposure. WHAT YOU'LL GET We take care of the people who take care of our patients. • Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work. • Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure. • Fully Remote — Work remote with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in. • Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them. • A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is. • A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do. If you read this and thought that's exactly the kind of problem I want to own — we'd love to hear from you.
